concerns.text: T102's sensitivity_summary.csv deliverable specifies only `window_length`, `correlation`, `empirical_p_value`, but the contract requires `correlation_coefficient`, `p_value`, `permutation_p_value`, and `n_samples`. The produced table would fail contract validation and silently drops the parametric p-value column required by SC-002 ('correlation coefficient (r) and p-value').

US-3 scenario 1 requires 'an empirical p-value is written to permutation_results.csv', but T102 defines that file as one row per shuffle with only `shuffle_id` and `correlation` columns, relocating the p-value to regression_summary.csv. This silently drops an acceptance criterion rather than amending the spec.

The FlexibilityMetric contract makes `null_flexibility_mean` and `excess_flexibility` REQUIRED fields, and data-model.md Data Flow step 4 says dynamics.py generates the phase-randomized null model — but no task (preserved or new) implements it. Either add a task or the contract is being silently violated by every produced artifact.

FR-005 specifies the predictor as `network_flexibility` (raw), while the RegressionResult contract defines `coefficient_flexibility` as the beta for *excess* flexibility. The preserved regression task and T104 tests never state which predictor is fit; the ambiguity means one of the two artifacts is being violated no matter what is implemented.

concerns.text: The contract requires `ci_lower`/`ci_upper` (95% CI for the flexibility coefficient) and the constitution mandates 'effect sizes and confidence intervals MUST be reported for the primary predictor', but no task deliverable or verification step mentions computing or writing CIs into regression_summary.csv.

Data model specifies `data/processed/fmri_clean/{id}.nii.gz` and `data/interim/results.csv`; tasks write `data/processed/{subject_id}_preprocessed.nii.gz` and `data/interim/regression_summary.csv` (absent from the data model's schema). Reconcile paths so verification is unambiguous.

T108 writes the results handoff into `specs/518-brain-dynamics-creativity/research.md`, but the actual artifact directory is `specs/001-investigating-the-relationship-between-b/` (as in this tasks.md header). The path mismatch will break execution.
